subject: Preventing evaluation lapse — temporary promo credits while PO in legal
body:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@stellapps.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation window ending — PO in legal review

Hi Karthik,

Quick note — procurement at StellApps has the PO queued with legal for review; they estimate clearance in another 7-10 business days. Our trial seats are expiring next Monday and the team still needs one more round of throughput testing on our 20k-doc corpus. Is there a way to keep the sandbox live or get temporary credits so we don't lose continuity?

Attaching the PO scan from procurement so you can see the request.

Thanks,
Sanjay
Senior ML Engineer
StellApps
Attachment: PO_Scan.png (image/png)

---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@stellapps.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation window ending — PO in legal review

Thanks for the heads-up, Sanjay — appreciate the PO scan.

We can offer a temporary access continuation while your PO clears. Two quick clarifications before I lock this in:
- How many concurrent worker slots do you need for the throughput run?
- Do you want the sandbox to remain on the hosted Redwood API or would you prefer a short-lived Dedicated allocation?

My proposal: a 14-day promotional credit bucket (10,000 tokens) to prevent the workflow from stalling. I need one internal approval for anything over 5k credits — looping Marissa from Solutions to confirm approvals and any billing flags.

If procurement is definitely >10 business days, we can extend to a 30-day promo credit term but that requires EM approval.

Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: SLA_summary.pdf (application/pdf)

---
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@stellapps.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation window ending — PO in legal review

Hi Karthik,

Thanks — we only need the hosted sandbox. Concurrency low (2 workers), but the team will run a heavier job this week that will consume tokens quickly. Procurement estimates 12 business days to complete the legal review. Can we do the 14-day 10k credit? That should be enough to finish the final pass.

Sanjay

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation window ending — PO in legal review

Karthik — I reviewed the account and the deal history (RDW-7421). Approving a one-time 14-day promotional credit of 10,000 tokens to prevent evaluation lapse.

Notes for ops: apply promo code PROMO-RDW-7421-14D to the StellApps sandbox environment, scope: hosted API, cap at 10k tokens, expiry 2026-07-14T23:59:00Z. No billing override needed; mark as trial-keepalive.

Please confirm to Sanjay once the credit is applied and attach the HubSpot deal link in the reply.

-Marissa
Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference

---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@stellapps.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation window ending — temporary promo credits applied

Sanjay — quick update: I applied a 14-day promo credit (PROMO-RDW-7421-14D) for 10,000 tokens to your hosted sandbox. It will expire on 2026-07-14T23:59:00Z. You should see the additional capacity immediately; no action required from your side.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/7421
Attachments: PO_Scan.png (we kept it in the deal record)

If procurement clears sooner and you want to convert to Reserved/Dedicated, happy to discuss next steps.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
